5661.title: Fix Alpine apk bootstrap artifact pin
5661.body:
Use the available Alpine 3.21 apk-tools-static 2.14.13-r0 archive and its verified SHA-256. The previous 2.14.6-r3 archive now returns HTTP 404, preventing musl build images from bootstrapping.


(cherry picked from commit 55c03c000afa46e4d3b659fb80b2ae70e3af26d5)

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5586.title: [release/4.154.x] Use Windows SDK resource compiler for ANGLE
5586.body:
Backport only the resource-compiler fix from mono/SkiaSharp#5537 (f515dd58d9782a208a569532512db736838c7a22). Remove the Chromium rc.exe GCS download, preserving preprocessing and header dependency tracking while compiling resources with the Windows SDK compiler. Retain expected-shape checks and idempotent writes.

Use this servicing branch's System.IO.File read/write helpers instead of the newer Cake helpers. Leave LLVM/bootstrap code and all dependency pins unchanged.

Validation: dotnet cake native/winui-angle/build.cake --dryrun passed; pinned chromium/6275 build a18493935f13d1b0992c78f5615a5d10336d60c0 rc.py transformation compiled, rejected missing anchors, and remained byte/mtime identical across repeated applications; git diff --check passed. Windows x86/x64/arm64 native builds are unavailable on macOS; original PR public AzDO build 1657048 is historical evidence only.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
